messages:
maria_docs: Heads-up — opened PR #5123 updating docs/guides/data-handling.md. It includes a code snippet that accidentally references an internal hostname (svc.internal.redwood). This doc needs security + legal sign-off before merge. Also, docs preview currently reports a broken link.

alex_eng: Can you point to the exact snippet? If it's a dummy hostname we should switch to localhost or a clearly redacted token.

maria_docs: It's in the example code block, looks like `https://svc.internal.redwood/api`. I'm proposing to replace with `${REDACTED_HOST}` and show env var usage for the API key. Will update now.

jess_pm: Timeline concern — customer migration guide depends on this landing by Friday. Can we gate merge on approvals and schedule a manual merge window?

sam_security: I can take a look today. Action items: remove any construct that could look like a real internal endpoint; prefer `localhost` or `example.internal` and ensure auth shown via `process.env.RW_API_KEY`. Also add a short note about KMS/HSM usage and masking secrets in logs.

legal_ops: I'll review the retention wording and redaction language. If there are sample identifiers that could be mistaken for PHI/PII we need to redact and include the legal-approved template. Expect feedback by EOD PST.

docs-preview-bot: preview build failed — linkcheck error in docs/guides/data-handling.md line 90: 404 on external link. Preview: https://preview.redwood.inference/docs/5123-preview

alex_eng: That link pointed to an old internal RFC. I'll swap it to the public design doc URL and push a tiny fix.

maria_docs: Pushed edits: replaced hostname with `${REDACTED_HOST}`, switched auth to `process.env.RW_API_KEY`, added a short KMS note and redaction template. Removed the broken link and updated to the public design doc URL. Re-running CI.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #5123 — running docs-preview, linkcheck, lint. Build: https://ci.redwood.inference/builds/98812

ci-bot: docs-preview passed ✅ — https://preview.redwood.inference/docs/5123-preview

sam_security: Reviewed inline. Left two tiny wording suggestions re: KMS integration and log masking. Approve after those are applied. 

legal_ops: Reviewed and left one edit for the retention table. Approve pending that change. 

maria_docs: Applied both suggested edits, added the legal redaction template as a snippet, and tagged the PR `needs-legal`, `needs-security`, `docs-ready-to-merge`.

alex_eng: Local checks look good. If legal + security approve, propose manual merge tomorrow 09:00 PT to minimize risk. I'll notify release owners.

jess_pm: 09:00 PT works for the migration cutover. Please include rollback steps in the PR body.

maria_docs: Added rollback instructions. Will merge manually at 09:00 PT after final thumbs. Not enabling auto-merge.

sam_security: Final thumbs — wording tweak applied. :thumbsup:

legal_ops: Final approval given. :white_check_mark:

maria_docs: Merging at 09:00 PT. Filing a follow-up ticket to scan docs for internal hostnames and to add a docs linter rule for domain patterns like `*.redwood.local`. Thanks all.

alex_eng: Happy to help with the linter rule. Suggest a CI check that flags `redwood.local` and similar patterns.

maria_docs: Agreed — opening infra ticket after merge. Closing thread once merged. :lock:
